description: This file defines the SupabaseConfig class responsible for configuring, validating, and initializing the Supabase client within a Flutter application. It includes methods for URL normalization, validation, connectivity checking, and a flexible initialization process with retries. The class exposes the initialized client and effective URL for external use.

classes.name: SupabaseConfig
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods and properties to configure and initialize the Supabase client, including URL validation and retry logic.

methods.name: _normalizeUrl
methods.description: Standardizes the provided URL by ensuring the https scheme and removing trailing slashes.

methods.name: _validateUrl
methods.description: Checks the URL for common format issues and returns a list of error messages if any.

methods.name: _checkConnectivity
methods.description: Performs a simple HTTP HEAD request to verify connectivity to the Supabase URL.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Loads environment variables, validates the URL, checks connectivity, and initializes the Supabase client with retries.
